full_path.description: Resolve path components under each containing directory's effective case-sensitivity configuration; do not normalize filenames unconditionally.

directory.description: Directory component lookup follows the effective case-sensitivity configuration of the parent directory.

name.description: Filename lookup follows the containing directory's effective case-sensitivity configuration.

selector_case_semantics.scanner_discovery: On Windows, query the containing directory's case-sensitive flag before enforcing exact path-name matching; Microsoft documents fsutil.exe file queryCaseSensitiveInfo <path>. API implementations must also account for filesystem and Win32 API-specific lookup behavior. Do not assume NTFS case-insensitive lookup universally.

hive.description: Use the canonical hive enum; do not use a generic string case switch.

key.description: Registry key lookup follows Windows Registry API key identity, which is case-insensitive.

name.description: Registry value name lookup follows Windows Registry API value-name identity, which is case-insensitive.
